'''AZ 77''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[XQ3 Platform]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Naval]] forces led by [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|frigate]] [[Implacable (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Implacable'']] attacked platform ''AZ 77'' in hopes to lure [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[MC40a light cruiser/Legends|MC40a light cruiser]] [[Ardent (MC40a light cruiser)|''Ardent'']] into an ambush. Just as the attack started, a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 transport]] ''[[Neenoc]]'' attempted to escape. Despite being defended by [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] and a [[IPV-1 System Patrol Craft|System Patrol Craft]] ''[[Derdmin]]'', the platform was destroyed. The plan worked and the ''Ardent'' arrived with [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] and [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] to retaliate, but the ''Ardent'' and the fighters were destroyed in the battle.

The battle was then recreated and used in training simulators for [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptor]] [[TIE pilot|pilots]], including [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].
